_comment: Sanitized reference of the production realm — NOT importable. Generated by scripts/sanitize-realm-export.py; see docs/keycloak/README.md. Hand-corrected 2026-09-23 to the target shape of three owner decisions of 2026-09-22 (ADR-0202 amendment 1): basetool-sc-extractor standardFlowEnabled false with no redirect URI, basetool-android without the two ingest scopes, basetool-frontend without http://frontend:18081. Hand-corrected 2026-09-25 for ADR-0202 amendment 3: basetool-frontend baseUrl set to the public origin (REQ-SEC-071). Hand-corrected 2026-09-28 for the ADR-0217 amendment of that day: basetool-sc-extractor client.session.idle.timeout 2592000 and client.session.max.lifespan 7776000. Production carries all three: the first since the provisioner apply of 2026-09-23, the second since the owner's hand edit of 2026-09-25, the third since the go-live's provisioner apply (S15) of 2026-09-28 - corrected 2026-09-28, this said production carried them only after a later apply. A regeneration from a fresh export replaces these hand-corrections. Hand-corrected 2026-09-28 for ADR-0202 amendment 5 (owner decision of that day, SC Extractor 2.10.0 sign-in refused 400 not_allowed): default-roles-iri gains the realm role offline_access as a composite, fixed on production by hand the same day. scopeMappings holds only the offline_access client scope's mapping to the offline_access realm role, which production already had before the fix, added by hand; the sanitizer keeps scopeMappings since 2026-09-28, so a regeneration brings every entry. Hand-corrected 2026-09-28 for the narrowing of ADR-0202 amendment 5 (owner decision of that day): basetool-frontend, backend-service, basetool-ingest-gateway and grafana without the optional scope offline_access, and defaultOptionalClientScopes without it, the target shape; production keeps it on them until the owner applies the provisioner for it (docs/archive/INGEST_KEYCLOAK_SETUP.md, Withholding offline_access from the first-party clients). Hand-corrected 2026-10-17 for ADR-0202 amendment 7 (#2674): the client basetool-android with its dpop-refresh-only client role, the client profile krt-mobile-dpop and the client policy krt-mobile-dpop-policy removed; production's client was deleted by hand the same day, and the provisioner deletes the profile and policy wherever they remain.
